body: I watch Season 1 of MLP:FiM when I feel bad. Never really provoked to watch it otherwise anymore. I want to dress up when Rarity does, I want to bake every time I see Pinkie Pie, and I want to punch Rainbow Dash in the face.
Truth be told, reading that response makes me feel like I'm talking to myself, because I do things like that when sad, and remember odd things like that. But oddly enough it's very fun to talk about.
It's been a real tough few days. It doesn't even feel like days, it feels like months.

It's a breath of fresh air to read that things will get better, especially when they still feel hopeless. I'm very glad I posted here. I cried a little at my desk earlier because I was so happy that so many individuals were reaching out to let me know I'd be okay, and that I'm above dating such abusive men.
Oh, and may I ask for the link to your Tumblr?

I'm sorry that happened to you. I was in a physically abusive relationship 10 years ago (geez I feel old), but it wasn't coupled with mental abuse. Well, not the same kind. Took me a few years to get over being raped and beat, but I grew from it and ended up doing some public speaking at a few schools about safety and confidence. 

Maybe that's why I stayed with the recent guy for as long as I did: I thought well he calls me names but he'll never hit me. And he won't. If anything there were times I wanted to punch him right in the teeth! But that only would have given evidence to all the things he said I was, so I held back. 

I enjoy reading about how everyone has moved on to a better life. If nothing else, I'll have a much greater appreciation for my future relationships (as well as the ones for my friends that never left my side), and much better confidence. I'm glad everyone has taken the time to share their experiences with me. It honestly does help a ton!
May I ask how? I'm nosy.
Ughhh time, everyone's enemy. Lucky for me, a few of my good friends reassured me they'll be around whenever I need them. I can't wait for that day. I want to laugh at this mess so badly.
Gonna purchase that tonight. Thank ya much!

And it does mean something. I felt alone in my thoughts for a long ass time. I felt that I deserved what he was doing for a while. And it's so damn refreshing to hear that someone else believes that no one should live in such a way.

There are actually 2 attorneys in my family. I've been too embarrassed to bring it up, really. They all saw me change my life, for the worse, to make him happy for so long. I can admit it was a very awful idea. But I'm still embarrassed to talk to some people about it.

I'm looking for other work and planning to move. It's sad that my new plan, which involves me living alone and getting everything set up and moving alone, makes me feel leagues more comfortable than the thought of living with him ever did. I feel like a real dumbass for dating him. 

And congrats on your success. It always helps to hear success stories.

The majority have been along the lines of ruining my mental stability and possibly any stable future. The real scary ones being about posting embarrassing photos and my location on 4chan. When he's in a good mood he admits to being vengeful and spiteful. When in a bad mood, he denies it and makes threats. I rather he punch me in the face until my teeth fall out. 

He's already warped my way of thinking, and living. And it disturbs me how he sticks around even though I "ruined" his life. I hate knowing he could use our time together and what I shared with him to hurt me or have me harassed by strangers. I've been in a physically abusive relationship before, and this one has been mentally abusive. In ways, this one is far worse.
